content_zh:
「婢子是小苹啊。」

「这是哪里？」

「贪欢楼的栖云小楼啊。」小苹满面狐疑地看着自家姑娘，不懂姑娘为什么问些傻话。

关舜华的心越沉越深，最终完全沉入绝望。

「……镜子。」又不知道过了多久，她从齿缝挤出两个字。

「哦。」小苹起身去拿了菱花镜过来。

关舜华暗暗吸了口气，这才接过她递来的镜子定睛看去。

镜中的这张脸，尽管倾国倾城，可是——不是她的脸！

关舜华瞬间崩溃了！

「不——」她发出绝望而凄厉的喊声。

京城，相府后宅。

相府小姐投缳自缢被人及时救下，至今已经整整昏迷了三天还没有醒来。

每一次大夫都是摇着头离开，每一次陪着大夫来的关义成都是一脸的铁青。

能跟唐家结亲，是多少名门闺秀求而不得的事，怎么他的女儿就这般的抗拒，甚至不惜以自杀来表达自己坚定的决心？

他膝下只有一女，可谓是真正的掌上明珠，可他这掌上明珠的脾气却着实是太过刚烈了些。

万事都可商量，怎么可以如此决绝呢，让他这白发人送黑发人，情何以堪？

虽然人被救下来，可都已经过去三天了，他的女儿却始终没有睁开眼睛，人在一天天地消瘦下去。

三天，滴水未进，灌都灌不下去，眼见是回天乏术，让关义成是满心的苦楚，且他的老妻也因女儿而一病不起，整个相府可谓是塌了半边天。

而关义成朝中事务繁杂，又有政敌在旁虎视眈眈，内外煎熬之下，不过几日工夫，鬓角又添华发。

长长地低叹一声，关义成看着女儿憔悴的面容，缓缓叹了口气，早知如此，实在不该结下唐家这门亲啊，他明明都是为了她好啊。

「照顾好小姐。」关义成从床边的杌子起身，对一边的青衣婢女如是说道。

「是，老爷。」

最后又看了一眼昏迷不醒的女儿，关义成这才转身离去。

青衣婢女看着床上的小姐，忍不住低头落泪，她家小姐怎么会这样傻啊。人活着，事情总还有转圜余地，这人要是没了，就真的什么都不可能了啊。

「小荷姊姊，我做了棉棒，咱们给小姐润润唇吧。」

随着声音，一个绿衣婢女端着一个小盘掀起珠帘走了进来。

被称为「小荷姊姊」的青衣婢女「嗯」了一声，拿过小盘上盛水的小碗和一枝棉棒，开始一点点地替小姐润唇。

小荷和小叶是关舜华的两个贴身丫鬟，她投缳她们虽没被相爷责罚，可各自心头都很是内疚，觉得如果她们多长一点儿心眼，小姐就不会出事了。

但事已至此，两个人再担心，也只能尽自己所能地照顾，就盼着小姐能够醒转。

小荷替她们家小姐润唇，小叶则拧了帕子为她擦拭手脸。

两个丫鬟静静地做着自己的事，偶尔却会抬起手背擦一下不受控制落下的泪，直到做完了事情，便坐在床前的两个杌子上相对无言、满面愁绪。

沙漏里的沙悄然地流逝着。

夜半三更，床前丫鬟昏昏欲睡，脑袋点得如同捣蒜一般。

床上的人眼皮突然微微动了动，又过了一会儿，才仿佛推开了压在眼皮上的千重山，缓缓睁开了眼。

烛火映出一室的暖光，也映出床前两条身影。

柳悠悠心中先是一惊，紧接着便发现了异样。

这是间陌生的房间，两个人影是陌生的侍女，珠帘低垂，檀香轻袅，窗前琴台上的七弦琴静置，显然是大家闺秀的闺房。

她怎会在这儿？发生了什么事？

柳悠悠拧着眉回想，伸手往自己左胸下方摸去，却没有半点疼痛之感，更没有伤痕的触感。

为什么伤口不见了，反倒是喉咙疼痛得无法出声？

太多的为什么充斥在柳悠悠的脑中，让她一时间理不出个头绪来。

喉咙火烧火燎地疼，她试图开口要水，结果却惹得自己咳了起来。

两个正打瞌睡的丫鬟顿时一个激灵醒了过来，两双眼睛同时朝床上看过去，瞬间眼露惊喜，异口同声地喊道：「小姐，您醒了！」

听这称呼，柳悠悠心中就暗叫不妙。

还是小荷看她手捂在喉咙处，面露痛色，忙伸手点了小叶一下，「小叶，去找府里的大夫来，再派人告诉老爷，小姐醒了。」

「哎。」小叶一边抹泪，一边应声离开。

小荷则先端了杯温水给自家小姐润喉，然后又拧了帕子，帮她拭面，一边擦拭，一边低声道：「小姐，不是婢子说您，万般事情都有解决之法，哪里便要轻生了。您让老爷夫人白发人送黑发人情何以堪？小姐投缳伤了喉咙，这一时半会儿也说不了话，就别勉强了，好生养着吧。」

听她这样说，柳悠悠霎时了然，原来这身体的原主是上吊而亡，而她自己的灵魂则不知为何鬼使神差地落入了这具躯壳中。

这算是借屍还魂吗？

这样离奇的事情为什么会发生在自己身上？

一瞬间，柳悠悠思绪万千。

她有自己的难处，有自己的不得已，却不料这高门富户的小姐也会有以死才能解决的为难事……

柳悠悠心下一时恻然，这世上的人活着原来是各有难处，并不会因为各自的身分不同而被上天厚爱。

柳悠悠靠坐在床头默默地喝完了一杯水，一边思量着接下来要怎么做。

她这样该怎么回去找公子？这最后一次的任务也尚未结束……

柳悠悠没想过趁着换了个身子的机会抛开密探的身分，毕竟她还惦记着唐忠信，也希望能够了结这次任务，真正成为自由身，而非靠耍小手段，还要担忧自己哪一天身分被拆穿。

不久之后，就听外面脚步声杂沓，似乎有不少人往这里而来。

柳悠悠心中又是一惊。

如今身处之地不明、身分不明，对来人的身分亦是不清，要如何应对？

她悄悄吸口气，喉咙的疼痛蓦地让她瞬间安下心来，谢天谢地，这个时候她说不了话，自然也就无须开口应对了。

「华儿，你可算是醒了。」随着一声带着喜意的哭腔，一个中年妇人从珠帘处走进房，一下子就扑到了柳悠悠的身上。

柳悠悠一时愕然，心中却又升起一股酸楚，她已经许久没感受过家人的温情。

但是，紧接着走进来的身影却让柳悠悠的感慨尽退，一下子怔住了。

关义成，当朝宰相！

这么说，她这是借屍还魂到丞相之女的身上了？

关相爷也是这次调查的对象之一啊，如果她现在是关小姐的身分，那么调查起来应该就容易得多了。

然而想到此，她又在心中摇头，她用着关小姐的身体，却调查她的父亲，这总有些良心不安。可转念一想，她又觉得如果关相爷真的与事无涉，调查清楚反而是好的……不如，她就见机行事吧。

心下主意拿定，柳悠悠便坦然了起来。

「醒了便好，好好休息，莫让你母亲与我再替你担心。」关义成面对女儿的目光，带了几分无奈和安抚地说。

柳悠悠点了下头。

关义成见她情绪不那么激烈了，不禁松口气，只要情绪缓和下来，事情总是能好好说的。

一群人来得匆忙，去得也快，很快屋子里便又只剩下了柳悠悠和两个丫鬟。

「小姐，歇着吧。」

小荷扶着她又躺了回去，小叶帮着把床帷都放了下来。

躺在昏暗的床帷内，柳悠悠却一时无法入睡，只因事情实在是出乎她的想像。
content_en:
"My maid is Xiao Ping."

"Where is this?"

"The Qiyun Building in Tanhuan Building." Xiao Ping looked at her girl with suspicion, not understanding why the girl asked such silly questions.

Guan Shunhua's heart sank deeper and deeper, and finally fell into despair.

"...Mirror." She didn't know how long it took before she squeezed out two words between her teeth.

"Oh." Xiao Ping stood up and brought the diamond mirror over.

Guan Shunhua took a deep breath, then took the mirror she handed and looked at it intently.

The face in the mirror, although stunning, is not her face!

Guan Shunhua collapsed instantly!

"No-" She let out a desperate and shrill cry.

Capital, the back house of the Prime Minister's Mansion.

Miss Xiangfu committed suicide and was rescued in time. She has been in a coma for three days and has not yet woken up.

Every time the doctor would shake his head and leave, and every time Guan Yicheng who accompanied the doctor would have a livid look on his face.

Being able to get married to the Tang family was something that many famous ladies could only ask for. Why was his daughter so resistant and even willing to commit suicide to express her firm determination?

He only has one girl under his knees, who is truly the apple of his eye, but the temper of his apple of the eye is really too strong.

Everything is negotiable, how could he be so decisive? How could he be so embarrassed to let a man with white hair give a man with black hair?

Although the man was rescued, three days have passed, and his daughter has still not opened her eyes, and is losing weight day by day.

For three days, no water came in and the water could not be poured down. Seeing that there was no way to save the day, Guan Yicheng was filled with pain. Moreover, his old wife also fell ill because of their daughter. It can be said that half of the sky of the Prime Minister's Palace collapsed.

However, Guan Yicheng's affairs in the court were complicated, and there were political enemies watching eagerly. Under the torment both internally and externally, within a few days, his hair grew more beautiful on his temples.

With a long sigh, Guan Yicheng looked at his daughter's haggard face and sighed slowly. If he had known this, he really shouldn't have formed a family relationship with the Tang family. He was obviously doing it for her own good.

"Take good care of the young lady." Guan Yicheng stood up from the bedside and said to the maid in green on the side.

"Yes, sir."

After one last glance at his unconscious daughter, Guan Yicheng turned and left.

The maid in green clothes looked at the young lady on the bed and couldn't help but lower her head and shed tears. How could her young lady be so stupid?As long as a person is alive, there is always room for change. If this person is gone, nothing will really be possible.

"Sister Xiaohe, I made a cotton swab. Let's moisturize the lady's lips."

Following the sound, a maid in green clothes lifted up the bead curtain and walked in carrying a small plate.

The maid in green, known as "Sister Xiao He" said "Hmm", took the small bowl of water and a cotton swab on the small plate, and began to moisturize the young lady's lips little by little.

Xiao He and Xiao Ye were two of Guan Shunhua's personal maids. Although they were not punished by the prime minister when she fell in love with them, they both felt guilty and felt that if they had been more considerate, nothing would have happened to the young lady.

But the matter has come to this, no matter how worried the two of them are, they can only do their best to take care of her, hoping that the young lady will wake up.

Xiaohe moistened the lips of their young lady, while Xiaoye twisted the handkerchief to wipe her hands and face.

The two maids were doing their own thing quietly, and occasionally they would raise the backs of their hands to wipe the tears that fell uncontrollably. After finishing their work, they sat on the two stools in front of the bed and looked at each other in silence, with sad faces.

The sand in the hourglass flows quietly.

In the middle of the night, the maid in front of the bed was drowsy and her head was pounding like garlic.

The eyelids of the man on the bed suddenly moved slightly, and after a while, he seemed to push away the thousand mountains pressing on his eyelids, and slowly opened his eyes.

The candlelight reflected the warm light of the room, and also reflected the two figures in front of the bed.

Liu Youyou was shocked at first, and then she noticed something strange.

This is a strange room, the two figures are strange maids, the bead curtains are drooped, the sandalwood scent is gentle, and the lyre on the piano stand in front of the window stands still. It is obviously the boudoir of a lady.

Why is she here?What happened?

Liu Youyou frowned and thought about it, then reached out and touched the bottom of her left breast, but she didn't feel any pain, let alone any scar.

Why is the wound gone, but my throat is so painful that I can't make a sound?

Too many whys filled Liu Youyou's mind, leaving her unable to figure it out for a while.

Her throat was burning and she tried to ask for water, but she ended up coughing.

The two maids who were dozing off suddenly woke up with excitement. They looked towards the bed with two pairs of eyes. They were surprised and shouted in unison: "Miss, you're awake!"

Hearing this title, Liu Youyou felt something bad in her heart.

It was Xiao He who saw her hand covering her throat with a look of pain on her face, and hurriedly reached out and tapped Xiao Ye, "Xiao Ye, go find the doctor in the mansion, and then send someone to tell the master that the young lady is awake."

"Hey." Xiaoye said while wiping away tears and left.

Xiao He first brought a cup of warm water to his young lady to moisten her throat, then twisted the handkerchief and helped her wipe her face. While wiping her face, she whispered: "Miss, I didn't tell you that there is a solution to all things, and you will commit suicide. How can you let the white-haired man of the master and his wife give a favor to the black-haired lady? The young lady has hurt her throat and can't speak for a while, so don't force it, just take care of yourself."

Hearing what she said, Liu Youyou suddenly understood that the original owner of this body hanged himself to death, and her own soul fell into this body by accident for some unknown reason.

Is this considered resurrecting a dead body?

Why did such a bizarre thing happen to me?

For a moment, Liu Youyou had a lot of thoughts.

She had her own difficulties and her own last resorts, but she didn't expect that this young lady from a wealthy family would also have difficulties that could only be solved by death...

Liu Youyou felt pity for a moment. People in this world have their own difficulties in life, and they will not be loved by God because of their different status.

Liu Youyou sat on the bedside and drank a glass of water silently, while thinking about what to do next.

How should she go back to find the young master like this?This last mission is not over yet...

Liu Youyou never thought of taking advantage of the opportunity to change her body and put aside her identity as a spy. After all, she still cared about Tang Zhongxin and hoped to be able to complete this mission and truly become a free agent, instead of resorting to small tricks and worrying that one day her identity would be revealed.

Soon after, I heard the clatter of footsteps outside, and it seemed like many people were coming here.

Liu Youyou was shocked again.

Now that you are in an unknown place, your identity is unknown, and the identity of the person coming is also unknown. How should you deal with it?

She took a breath quietly, and the pain in her throat suddenly made her feel relieved. Thank God, she couldn't speak at this time, so she didn't need to speak to deal with it.

"Hua'er, you're finally awake." With a joyful cry, a middle-aged woman walked into the room from the bead curtain and threw herself on Liu Youyou's body.

Liu Youyou was stunned for a moment, but a sadness arose in her heart. It had been a long time since she had felt the warmth of her family.

However, the figure that walked in immediately made Liu Youyou withdraw from emotion and was stunned for a moment.

Guan Yicheng, the current prime minister!

So, she has reincarnated into the body of the prime minister's daughter?

Prime Minister Guan is also one of the targets of this investigation. If she is now Miss Guan, the investigation should be much easier.

However, thinking of this, she shook her head in her heart. She used Miss Guan's body to investigate her father, which always made her feel uneasy.But then she thought about it, and she felt that if Mr. Guan really had nothing to do with the matter, it would be better to investigate clearly... Why not, she would just act according to the situation.

After making up her mind, Liu Youyou became calm.

"Just wake up and have a good rest. Don't let your mother and I worry about you anymore." Guan Yicheng faced his daughter's gaze and said with a bit of helplessness and comfort.

Liu Youyou nodded.

Seeing that her emotions were no longer so intense, Guan Yicheng couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief. As long as her emotions calm down, things can always be discussed smoothly.

The group of people came and left quickly, and soon only Liu Youyou and the two maids were left in the room.

"Miss, please rest."

Xiaohe helped her lie back down, and Xiaoye helped lower the bed curtains.

Lying in the dark curtains of the bed, Liu Youyou couldn't fall asleep for a while, because things were beyond her imagination.
